## What's new

- **Background monitors can use your integrations.** Agent monitors can run integration command-line tools such as GitHub's with a read-only credential that expires on its own, so watching a pull request or CI run from a monitor now works.
- **Warnings before a slot claim expires.** Agents holding a capacity slot are told shortly before their claim runs out, so they can renew or release it in time.
- **Agents recover from failed resumes.** If an agent's resumed run fails while it holds a slot or a workflow attempt, Ficus wakes it again instead of leaving the work stuck.
- **Running apps first.** A squad's Local Apps list now shows running apps at the top.
- **Clearer selection in every theme.** Selected rows look distinct from hovered ones in all built-in themes, and the selected squad chat row and file tree row keep their highlight when you hover them.
- **Workspace settings stay protected.** Workspace file views, uploads and writes now leave the workspace settings directory alone, and agent sandbox controls are offered only to people allowed to use them.
- **Smaller fixes.** The Subagents tab shows its activity as one evenly spaced pill, and database connection timeouts are applied more reliably.
